answer: Opal Registry blocks fake-agent floods with a refundable identity bond: each agent deposits 2,400 POA into a Ferrous bond vault for 30 days before it can earn, and the bond returns only after 12 completed verified tasks. An Ember challenge key lets any peer force a re-check at any time; a failed check burns the full 2,400 POA. Fielding 250 fake agents freezes 600,000 POA for a month and risks burning it all, so the attack costs far more than any payout it could chase.
